title: Katekyo Hitman Reborn! Anime Reveals Eight and Final Opening Featuring "LISTEN TO THE STEREO!!" by Going Under Ground
content: Katekyo Hitman REBORN! anime has officially released the creditless version of its eight and final opening, featuring the song “LISTEN TO THE STEREO!!” by Going Under Ground. The song was used in Episodes 178-203, while the new video was released as part of the series’ 20th anniversary celebration.
author: Anime Corner

title: The Iceblade Sorcerer Shall Rule the World 2nd Season Anime Casts Shiki Aoki, Kazuyuki Okitsu
content: The website for the second season of the television anime based on Nana Mikoshiba 's The Iceblade Sorcerer Shall Rule the World ( Hyōken no Majutsushi ga Sekai wo Suberu - Sekai Saikyō no Majutsushi de Aru Shōnen wa, Majutsu Gakuin ga Nyūgaku Suru ) light novel series revealed two additional cast members on Thursday.
author: ANN

title: Isshiki-san Wants to Know About Love TV Anime Reveals New Visual, 4 More Cast Members
content: Kadokawa revealed more cast and a new visual on Thursday for the television anime of Ayune Araragi 's Isshiki-san Wants to Know About Love ( Isshiki-san wa Koi o Shiritai. ) manga.
author: ANN

title: Shin Oishinbo TV Anime Reveals Main Cast & Staff Members, 2027 Debut
content: The official website for Shin Oishinbo (New Oishinbo), the new television anime series of storywriter Tetsu Kariya and artist Akira Hanasaki 's Oishinbo manga, opened on Thursday and revealed the anime's teaser visual, main cast and staff members, and its 2027 debut.
author: ANN

title: 'Bless' Unveils Additional Cast, Character Promo
content: The official website for the television anime adaptation of Yukino Sonoyama 's Bless manga unveiled additional cast and the character promotional video on Thursday. The anime series is scheduled to premiere on Fuji TV's NoitaminA programming block at 11.30. p.m. in January 2027.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Rudy Takes Action in Mushoku Tensei Season 3 Episode 14 Preview

title: Magical Sisters Lulutto Lilly Anime Streams Main Trailer for 2nd Part
content: Bandai Namco Filmworks revealed on Thursday the main promotional video for the second cours (quarter of a year) of Mahō no Shimai Lulutto Lilly ( Magical Sisters Lulutto Lilly ), the new magical girl television anime that it is presenting with Studio Pierrot .
author: ANN
